name: to-dns-header
source: built by tools/gen/dirnaming-vectors.py from values chosen there; layout restated from RFC 1002 sections 4.1 and 4.2 and RFC 1035 section 4.1.1; the transaction ID and the R, AA, TC, RD and RA bits carry over; the NetBIOS opcode, B and rcode do not; expect derived there, no engine run
